moments.title: August Bank Holiday Weekend
moments.blurb: The last long weekend of summer arrives as the August Bank Holiday falls on Monday, August 31st, for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland.

angles.name: Last chance for summer fun
angles.copy: That's it, the last Bank Holiday of summer is here! What are your plans for the long weekend? Make it count!

angles.name: Travel warning
angles.copy: Planning a Bank Holiday getaway? Expect busy roads and potential rail disruptions across England, Wales, and Northern Ireland this weekend. Check before you travel!

moments.title: Premier League Matchweek 2 Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The second round of Premier League fixtures starts this Friday, August 28th, with Crystal Palace hosting Manchester City, followed by a busy weekend of top-flight action.

angles.name: Weekend fixtures hype
angles.copy: Premier League Matchweek 2 is almost here! Who are you backing this weekend? Crystal Palace vs Man City kicks things off Friday night!

angles.name: Local team focus (example)
angles.copy: After last week's draw, can Liverpool bag three points against Nottingham Forest on Saturday? Big weekend ahead!

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festival Takes Over Bank Holiday
moments.blurb: Reading & Leeds Festivals return for the Bank Holiday weekend, August 27-30, with headliners including Charli XCX, Dave, Florence + The Machine, Fontaines D.C., Chase & Status Live, and Raye.

angles.name: Festival vibe
angles.copy: It's almost time! Reading & Leeds Festival kicks off this Bank Holiday weekend. Who are you most excited to see on the lineup?

angles.name: Headliner shout-out
angles.copy: Florence + The Machine, Charli XCX, Dave, Fontaines D.C... the Reading & Leeds lineup is STACKED this weekend! Getting ready for some unforgettable sets.

moments.title: Creamfields Festival Returns
moments.blurb: One of the UK's biggest electronic music festivals, Creamfields, takes place this Bank Holiday weekend, August 27-30, in Daresbury, Cheshire, featuring Calvin Harris, Swedish House Mafia, Martin Garrix and more.

angles.name: Dance music pilgrimage
angles.copy: Creamfields is calling! The UK's biggest dance music festival kicks off this Thursday. Who's heading to Daresbury for the ultimate Bank Holiday rave?

angles.name: DJ Lineup highlight
angles.copy: Get ready for the beats! Calvin Harris, Swedish House Mafia, Martin Garrix, Tiësto – the Creamfields lineup is bringing the heat this weekend.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Florence Welch
moments.blurb: Florence Welch, the iconic lead singer of Florence + The Machine, celebrates her 40th birthday on August 28th.

angles.name: Birthday wishes
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 40th Birthday to the incredible Florence Welch! What's your favourite Florence + The Machine song?

angles.name: Musical talent
angles.copy: Happy 40th to the one and only Florence Welch! Her powerful vocals and unique style have given us so many anthems. What's your go-to track?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Shania Twain
moments.blurb: The Queen of Country Pop, Shania Twain, turns 61 on August 28th.

angles.name: Country legend celebration
angles.copy: Happy 61st Birthday to the incredible Shania Twain! From 'Man! I Feel Like A Woman!' to 'That Don't Impress Me Much', she's a true icon.

angles.name: Iconic hits
angles.copy: Let's hear it for Shania Twain, who celebrates her 61st birthday today! What's your all-time favourite song from the country superstar?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Van Morrison
moments.blurb: Northern Irish music legend Sir Van Morrison, known for classics like 'Brown Eyed Girl' and 'Moondance', celebrates his 81st birthday on August 31st.

angles.name: Legendary birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 81st Birthday to the incomparable Van Morrison! A true musical icon. What's his song that always gets you?

angles.name: Timeless tracks
angles.copy: Happy Birthday to Van the Man! Sir Van Morrison turns 81 today, still bringing us that soulful sound. Celebrate with your favourite track!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Debbie Gibson
moments.blurb: 80s pop sensation Debbie Gibson, who had multiple chart-topping hits as a teenager, celebrates her 56th birthday on August 31st.

angles.name: Pop princess birthday
angles.copy: Happy 56th Birthday to the incredible Debbie Gibson! She was a pop powerhouse in the 80s. What's your favourite hit from her?

angles.name: Teen icon
angles.copy: Forever our 'Electric Youth'! Happy Birthday to Debbie Gibson, turning 56 today. Relive those classic 80s pop vibes!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Al Jardine
moments.blurb: Al Jardine, co-founder and guitarist of the legendary Beach Boys, celebrates his 84th birthday on September 3rd.

angles.name: Beach Boys legend
angles.copy: Happy 84th Birthday to Al Jardine of The Beach Boys! Thanks for the timeless harmonies and surf-rock anthems.

angles.name: Summer vibes
angles.copy: It's Al Jardine's 84th Birthday! Keep those summer vibes going with a classic from The Beach Boys. Which one are you playing?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Beyoncé
moments.blurb: Global superstar Beyoncé, one of the best-selling music artists of all time, celebrates her 45th birthday on September 4th.

angles.name: Queen Bey celebration
angles.copy: All hail Queen Bey! Wishing a massive Happy 45th Birthday to the iconic Beyoncé. What's your ultimate Beyoncé anthem?

angles.name: Influence and legacy
angles.copy: Happy 45th Birthday to the one and only Beyoncé! Her impact on music, culture, and fashion is undeniable. Celebrate with a listen to her incredible catalogue.

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing Nears Return
moments.blurb: Anticipation builds for the return of Strictly Come Dancing, with the launch show reportedly set for September 19th and live shows starting September 26th, introducing new hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe.

angles.name: Strictly fever
angles.copy: Dust off your dancing shoes! Strictly Come Dancing is reportedly just weeks away from its big return. Are you ready for the glitterball magic?

angles.name: New hosts buzz
angles.copy: New hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe are set to take the Strictly ballroom by storm! What do you think of the new line-up?
